name: Analyze Protein Phylogeny
description: Perform phylogenetic analysis on a set of protein sequences. This function aligns sequences, constructs a phylogenetic tree, and visualizes evolutionary relationships.
detailed_description: Perform phylogenetic analysis on a set of protein sequences. This function aligns sequences, constructs a phylogenetic tree, and visualizes evolutionary relationships.
when_to_use: When you need analyze protein phylogeny analysis

parameters.fasta_sequences: [Required] Path to a FASTA file containing protein sequences or a string with FASTA-formatted sequences (str)
parameters.alignment_method: [Optional] Method for sequence alignment: "clustalw", "muscle", or "pre-aligned" (default: clustalw)
parameters.tree_method: [Optional] Method for tree construction: "iqtree" or fallback to neighbor-joining (default: fasttree)
